candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the order service is the origin of the failure, propagated as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db pool, redis, payment) not observable from gateway evidence; only the 500 origin is established.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway /v1/checkout 502 caused by order POST /v1/orders returning 500 across multiple correlation IDs. Gateway metrics show no dependency errors and low latency, so the fault originates in the order service. The specific order-side cause is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders to identify why it returns 500
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency
